facts.v: Made in six departments: Pyrénées-Atlantiques (Nouvelle-Aquitaine), and Ariège, Hautes-Pyrénées, Haute-Garonne, Aude and Pyrénées-Orientales (Occitanie)
Raw, thermised or pasteurised milk depending on the variety; rennet at about 32 °C for raw milk; curd cut and warmed to 35–40 °C, never over 45 °C; salted in brine or dry; ripened about 21 to 90 days
